zetaris.summary: Federated read path and Unified Semantic Layer namespace "recall" over file sources (handles, interactions, contacts, events) plus a Postgres calendar source.

meterless.summary: World Model (identity merge, conflicts, person context) and H-MEM (mine, hybrid retrieve, ledger).

cursor.summary: Project rules and a dated Cursor build log.

nvidia.summary: Nemotron chat via the shared generator, NVIDIA embeddings, and Parakeet ASR over Riva NVCF.

sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true runs on data/sample + data/cache with zero credentials; LLM and actions dry-run; live connectors and Zetaris are optional.
